title: 完整的天空

source.prompt: TrackType: Music, VocalType: Instrumental. Original instrumental retro fantasy tactical RPG score. Clear memorable NEW melody, compact four-voice counterpoint, warm pulse-wave lead, rounded triangle bass, gentle acoustic chamber colors, restrained noise percussion, clean mobile-speaker mix. No vocals, no choir, no speech, no lyrics; no quotation or imitation of any existing melody. 82 BPM, warm reflective epilogue for communities rebuilding and two young companions promising to meet again. Tender flute and harp exchange a new lyrical melody, gently broadened by strings and soft pulse counterpoint. Bittersweet hope, modest human scale, no triumphant bombast. Maintain steady repeating musical phrases throughout, no long introduction, no fade-out or final ending.
